```{r cleaning with glasses, echo = FALSE}
# Cleaning with glasses

            country_list <- list(aze, bfa, chn, dji, dom, geo, idn, irn, irq, ita, jor, ken, lbr, mdv, mmr, mng, mwi, npl, pol, sen, swe, tgo, tjk, ukr) 

    # rbind datasets where columns are identical; fill rest in with NA
        # plyr's rbind.fill can't handle date/time data, so remove this
        # drop all cols with 'date' or 'DATE' in the name 
            for (i in 1:length(country_list)) {
                country_list[[i]] <- country_list[[i]][, -grep('date', colnames(country_list[[i]]), ignore.case = TRUE)]  # do double [[]] b/c it's a list
            }
            alles_og <- rbind.fill(country_list)
            alles_og <- as.data.frame(alles_og)
            nrow(alles_og)
    # Missing data
        # Drop respondent if missing/DNR in any part of functioning module 
            alles <- alles_og[which(alles_og$MOBILITY %in% 0:3 & alles_og$SEEING %in% 0:3 & alles_og$HEARING %in% 0:3 & 
                                alles_og$COMM %in% 0:3 & alles_og$REMEMB %in% 0:3 & alles_og$SELFCARE %in% 0:3 & 
                                alles_og$AGE > -1 & alles_og$AGE < 130 &
                                alles_og$SEX > -1), ] # 2 people have insanely coded ages 
            nrow(alles)/nrow(alles_og) # 93.5
            nrow(alles_og) - nrow(alles) # 15,185
            table(alles$AGE)
            table(alles$SEX)

            alles$region <- rep(NA, nrow(alles))
            alles$hdi_score <- rep(NA, nrow(alles))
            alles$hdi_value <- rep(NA, nrow(alles))
            alles$hdi_rank <- rep(NA, nrow(alles))
            alles$gdi_value <- rep(NA, nrow(alles))

        # loop through ccs to add filter values to main dataset
            for (i in unique(alles$cc)) {
                that_country <- filters[which(filters$cc == i), 'country'] # take the filter value 
                that_region <- filters[which(filters$cc == i), 'region']
                that_hdi_score <- filters[which(filters$cc == i), 'hdi_score']
                that_hdi_value <- filters[which(filters$cc == i), 'hdi_value']
                that_hdi_rank <- filters[which(filters$cc == i), 'hdi_rank']
                that_gdi_value <- filters[which(filters$cc == i), 'gdi_value']
                
                alles[which(alles$cc == i), 'country'] <- that_country # paste this value into the respective column for all rows with that cc in the main dataset
                alles[which(alles$cc == i), 'region'] <- that_region
                alles[which(alles$cc == i), 'hdi_score'] <- that_hdi_score
                alles[which(alles$cc == i), 'hdi_value'] <- that_hdi_value
                alles[which(alles$cc == i), 'hdi_rank'] <- that_hdi_rank
                alles[which(alles$cc == i), 'gdi_value'] <- that_gdi_value
            }
        # Simplify hdi_score 
            alles[which(alles$hdi_score == '1. Low'), 'hdi_score'] <- 'low'
            alles[which(alles$hdi_score == '2. Medium'), 'hdi_score'] <- 'medium'
            alles[which(alles$hdi_score == '3. High'), 'hdi_score'] <- 'high'
            alles[which(alles$hdi_score == '4. Very high'), 'hdi_score'] <- 'vhigh'

    # Add ID for our purposes
        alles$rn <- 1:nrow(alles)
        alles$id <- paste0(alles$cc, alles$rn)

    # Add any fd
        alles$any_fd <- rep(0, nrow(alles)) 
        alles[which(alles$MOBILITY > 0 | alles$SEEING > 0 | alles$HEARING > 0 | alles$COMM > 0 | alles$REMEMB > 0 | alles$SELFCARE > 0), 'any_fd'] <- 1
        alles$need2 <- rep(0, nrow(alles)) 
        alles[which(alles$MOBILITY > 1 | alles$SEEING > 1 | alles$HEARING > 1 | alles$COMM > 1 | alles$REMEMB > 1 | alles$SELFCARE > 1), 'fd2'] <- 1
    
    # Add single fd

        alles[which(alles$MOBILITY > 0 & alles$SEEING == 0 & alles$HEARING == 0 & alles$COMM == 0 & alles$REMEMB == 0 & alles$SELFCARE == 0), 'single_fd'] <- 1
        alles[which(alles$MOBILITY == 0 & alles$SEEING > 0 & alles$HEARING == 0 & alles$COMM == 0 & alles$REMEMB == 0 & alles$SELFCARE == 0), 'single_fd'] <- 1
        alles[which(alles$MOBILITY == 0 & alles$SEEING == 0 & alles$HEARING > 0 & alles$COMM == 0 & alles$REMEMB == 0 & alles$SELFCARE == 0), 'single_fd'] <- 1
        alles[which(alles$MOBILITY == 0 & alles$SEEING == 0 & alles$HEARING == 0 & alles$COMM > 0 & alles$REMEMB == 0 & alles$SELFCARE == 0), 'single_fd'] <- 1
        alles[which(alles$MOBILITY == 0 & alles$SEEING == 0 & alles$HEARING == 0 & alles$COMM == 0 & alles$REMEMB > 0 & alles$SELFCARE == 0), 'single_fd'] <- 1
        alles[which(alles$MOBILITY == 0 & alles$SEEING == 0 & alles$HEARING == 0 & alles$COMM == 0 & alles$REMEMB == 0 & alles$SELFCARE > 0), 'single_fd'] <- 1

    # Add multiple fd 
        alles$multi_fd <- rep('no multi', nrow(alles))
        alles[which(alles$single_fd == 0 & alles$any_fd == 1), 'multi_fd'] <- 'has multi'
    # One var for n of fds
        alles$fdn <- rep('3.none', nrow(alles))
        alles[which(alles$single_fd == 1), 'fdn'] <- '1.single'
        alles[which(alles$multi_fd == 'has multi'), 'fdn'] <- '2.multiple'
    # High vs low fd
        alles$high_fd <- rep('3', nrow(alles))
        alles[which(alles$MOBILITY > 2 | alles$SEEING > 2 | alles$HEARING > 2 | alles$COMM > 2 | alles$REMEMB > 2 | alles$SELFCARE), 'high_fd'] <- '1' # any reported difficulty is over 2
        alles[which(alles$any_fd == 1 & alles$MOBILITY < 2 & alles$SEEING < 2 & alles$HEARING < 2 & alles$COMM < 2 & alles$REMEMB < 2 & alles$SELFCARE), 'high_fd'] <- '1' # difficulty IS reported, but it is under 2 in any/all cases (to compare to multiple FDs)

    # Add domain & any use 
        # Mobility
            alles$mob_use <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$mob_sum <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$mob_sum <- rowSums(alles[,c(108:127)])
            alles[which(alles$mob_sum > 0), 'mob_use'] <- 1
        # Vision
            alles$vis_use <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$vis_sum <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$vis_sum <- rowSums(alles[,c(128:138)])
            alles[which(alles$vis_sum > 0), 'vis_use'] <- 1
        # Hearing
            alles$hear_use <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$hear_sum <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$hear_sum <- rowSums(alles[,c(139:145)])
            alles[which(alles$hear_sum > 0), 'hear_use'] <- 1
        # Communication
            alles$com_use <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$com_sum <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$com_sum <- rowSums(alles[,c(146:149)])
            alles[which(alles$com_sum > 0), 'com_use'] <- 1
        # Remembering
            alles$rem_use <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$rem_sum <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$rem_sum <- rowSums(alles[,c(150:156)])
            alles[which(alles$rem_sum > 0), 'rem_use'] <- 1    
        # Self-care
            alles$self_use <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$self_sum <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$self_sum <- rowSums(alles[,c(157:163)])
            alles[which(alles$self_sum > 0), 'self_use'] <- 1
        # Any use 
            alles$any_use <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles[which(alles$mob_use > 0 | alles$vis_use > 0 | alles$hear_use > 0 | 
                        alles$com_use > 0 | alles$rem_use > 0 | alles$self_use > 0), 'any_use'] <- 1

    # Add domain & any unmet need 
        # Mobility
            alles$mob_unmet <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$mob_sum <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$mob_sum <- rowSums(alles[,c(163:182)])
            alles[which(alles$mob_sum > 0), 'mob_unmet'] <- 1
        # Vision
            alles$vis_unmet <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$vis_sum <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$vis_sum <- rowSums(alles[,c(183:193)])
            alles[which(alles$vis_sum > 0), 'vis_unmet'] <- 1
        # Hearing
            alles$hear_unmet <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$hear_sum <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$hear_sum <- rowSums(alles[,c(194:200)])
            alles[which(alles$hear_sum > 0), 'hear_unmet'] <- 1
        # Communication
            alles$com_unmet <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$com_sum <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$com_sum <- rowSums(alles[,c(201:204)])
            alles[which(alles$com_sum > 0), 'com_unmet'] <- 1
        # Remembering
            alles$rem_unmet <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$rem_sum <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$rem_sum <- rowSums(alles[,c(205:211)])
            alles[which(alles$rem_sum > 0), 'rem_unmet'] <- 1    
        # Self-care
            alles$self_unmet <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$self_sum <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles$self_sum <- rowSums(alles[,c(212:217)])
            alles[which(alles$self_sum > 0), 'self_unmet'] <- 1
        # Any unmet 
            alles$any_unmet <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
            alles[which(alles$mob_unmet > 0 | alles$vis_unmet > 0 | alles$hear_unmet > 0 | 
                        alles$com_unmet > 0 | alles$rem_unmet > 0 | alles$self_unmet > 0), 'any_unmet'] <- 1
    # Add met need and total need indicators 
        # met need 
        alles$met_need <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
        alles[which(alles$any_use == 1 & alles$any_unmet == 0), 'any_met'] <- 1
        # need 
        alles$any_need <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
        alles[which(alles$any_met == 1 | alles$any_unmet == 1), 'any_need'] <- 1


    # Dichotomise satisfaction vars 
        # Products
        alles$dspr <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
        alles[which(alles$SATPR1 %in% c(1,2)), 'dspr'] <- 1
        alles[which(alles$SATPR2 %in% c(1,2)), 'dspr'] <- 1
        alles[which(alles$SAPTPR3 %in% c(1,2)), 'dspr'] <- 1

        # Assessment 
        alles$dsas <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
        alles[which(alles$SVCPR1 %in% c(1,2) | alles$SVCPR2 %in% c(1,2) | alles$SVCPR3 %in% c(1,2)), 'dsas'] <- 1
        
        # Follow-up 
        alles$dsfu <- rep(0, nrow(alles))
        alles[which(alles$SATFU1 %in% c(1,2) | alles$SATFU2 %in% c(1,2) | alles$SATFU3 %in% c(1,2)), 'dsfu'] <- 1

    # Age groups 
        # 3 main groups
        alles$age3 <- rep('18-64', nrow(alles))
        alles[which(alles$AGE < 18), 'age3'] <- '0-17'
        alles[which(alles$AGE > 64), 'age3'] <- '65+'
        # 10 year age groups 
        alles$age10 <- rep(NA, nrow(alles))
        alles[which(alles$AGE < 10), 'age10'] <- '0-9'
        alles[which(alles$AGE > 9 & alles$AGE < 20), 'age10'] <- '10-19'
        alles[which(alles$AGE > 19 & alles$AGE < 30), 'age10'] <- '20-29'
        alles[which(alles$AGE > 29 & alles$AGE < 40), 'age10'] <- '30-39'
        alles[which(alles$AGE > 39 & alles$AGE < 50), 'age10'] <- '40-49'
        alles[which(alles$AGE > 49 & alles$AGE < 60), 'age10'] <- '50-59'
        alles[which(alles$AGE > 59 & alles$AGE < 70), 'age10'] <- '60-69'
        alles[which(alles$AGE > 69 & alles$AGE < 80), 'age10'] <- '70-79'
        alles[which(alles$AGE >79), 'age10'] <- '80+'
    # Age / 5 
        # divide Age by 5 for models 
        alles$ageby5 <- alles$AGE/5
    # HDI / 0.005 
        # divide hdi_value by 5 for models 
        alles$hdiby5 <- alles$hdi_value/5
    
    # HDI reference group
```

```{r cleaning WITHOUT glasses, echo = FALSE}
        alles_g[which(alles_g$AGE < 10), 'age10'] <- '0-9'
        alles_g[which(alles_g$AGE > 9 & alles_g$AGE < 20), 'age10'] <- '10-19'
        alles_g[which(alles_g$AGE > 19 & alles_g$AGE < 30), 'age10'] <- '20-29'
        alles_g[which(alles_g$AGE > 29 & alles_g$AGE < 40), 'age10'] <- '30-39'
        alles_g[which(alles_g$AGE > 39 & alles_g$AGE < 50), 'age10'] <- '40-49'
        alles_g[which(alles_g$AGE > 49 & alles_g$AGE < 60), 'age10'] <- '50-59'
        alles_g[which(alles_g$AGE > 59 & alles_g$AGE < 70), 'age10'] <- '60-69'
        alles_g[which(alles_g$AGE > 69 & alles_g$AGE < 80), 'age10'] <- '70-79'
        alles_g[which(alles_g$AGE >79), 'age10'] <- '80+'
    # Age / 5 
        # divide Age by 5 for models 
        alles_g$ageby5 <- alles_g$AGE/5
    # HDI / 0.005 
        # divide hdi_value by 5 for models 
        alles_g$hdiby5 <- alles_g$hdi_value/5
    # HDI reference group 
        alles_g[which(alles_g$hdi_score == 'low'), 'hdi_score'] <- 'a_low'
        alles_g[which(alles_g$hdi_score == 'medium'), 'hdi_score'] <- 'b_medium'
        alles_g[which(alles_g$hdi_score == 'high'), 'hdi_score'] <- 'c_high'
        alles_g[which(alles_g$hdi_score == 'vhigh'), 'hdi_score'] <- 'd_vhigh'
    # Save 
        # wg <- createWorkbook()
        # addWorksheet(wg, sheetName = "alles_g") 
        # writeDataTable(wg, sheet = "alles_g", x = as.data.frame(alles_g), colNames = T, rowNames = T, tableStyle = 'TableStyleLight11')
        # saveWorkbook(wg, 'alles_g.xlsx', overwrite = T)

    # Cleaned data: alles_g
```

```{r Use, echo = FALSE}
# Use, males x females, 1 plot per HDI score group 
    # Low HDI
        # males 
            # subset data
            lm <- alles[which(alles$hdi_score == 'low' & alles$SEX == 1), ]
            table(alles$hdi_score)
            # calculate proportions
            use_low_males <- table(lm$any_use, lm$age10)
            ulmcs <- colSums(use_low_males)
            ulm <- rbind(use_low_males, ulmcs)
            no_use <- ulm[1, ]
            use <- ulm[2, ]
            use_perc <- as.numeric(round((ulm[2, ]/ulm[3, ])*100, 2))
            # add labels 
            table(alles$hdi_score)
            age_groups <- c('0-9', '10-19', '20-29', '30-39', '40-49', '50-59', '60-69', '70-79', '80+')
            category <- rep('Male (low HDI)', 9)
            ulmp_df <- cbind(age_groups, use, no_use, use_perc, category)
            
            # convert to df and numeric
            ulmp_df <- as.data.frame(ulmp_df)
            ulmp_df$use_perc <- as.numeric(ulmp_df$use_perc)

        # females
            # subset data 
            lf <- alles[which(alles$hdi_score == 'low' & alles$SEX == 2), ]
            
            # calculate proportions 
            use_low_females <- table(lf$any_use, lf$age10)
            ulfcs <- colSums(use_low_females)
            ulf <- rbind(use_low_females, ulfcs)
            no_use <- ulf[1, ]
            use <- ulf[2, ]
```

```{r Unmet, echo = FALSE}
            unmet_perc <- as.numeric(round((uhf[2, ]/uhf[3, ])*100, 2))
            
            # add labels 
            age_groups <- c('0-9', '10-19', '20-29', '30-39', '40-49', '50-59', '60-69', '70-79', '80+')
            category <- rep('4. Female (high HDI)', 9)
            uhfp_df <- cbind(age_groups, unmet, no_unmet, unmet_perc, category)
            
            # convert to df and numeric
            uhfp_df <- as.data.frame(uhfp_df)
            uhfp_df$unmet_perc <- as.numeric(uhfp_df$unmet_perc)

    # Very high HDI
        # males 
            # subset data
            vhm <- alles[which(alles$hdi_score == 'vhigh' & alles$SEX == 1), ]
            
            # calculate proportions
            unmet_vhigh_males <- table(vhm$any_unmet, vhm$age10)
            uvhmcs <- colSums(unmet_vhigh_males)
            uvhm <- rbind(unmet_vhigh_males, uvhmcs)
            no_unmet <- uvhm[1, ]
            unmet <- uvhm[2, ]
            unmet_perc <- as.numeric(round((uvhm[2, ]/uvhm[3, ])*100, 2))
            
            # add labels 
            age_groups <- c('0-9', '10-19', '20-29', '30-39', '40-49', '50-59', '60-69', '70-79', '80+')
            category <- rep('1. Male (very high HDI)', 9)
            uvhmp_df <- cbind(age_groups, unmet, no_unmet, unmet_perc, category)
            
            # convert to df and numeric
            uvhmp_df <- as.data.frame(uvhmp_df)
            uvhmp_df$unmet_perc <- as.numeric(uvhmp_df$unmet_perc)

        # females
            # subset data 
            vhf <- alles[which(alles$hdi_score == 'vhigh' & alles$SEX == 2), ]
            
            # calculate proportions 
            unmet_vhigh_females <- table(vhf$any_unmet, vhf$age10)
            uvhfcs <- colSums(unmet_vhigh_females)
            uvhf <- rbind(unmet_vhigh_females, uvhfcs)
            no_unmet <- uvhf[1, ]
            unmet <- uvhf[2, ]
            unmet_perc <- as.numeric(round((uvhf[2, ]/uvhf[3, ])*100, 2))
            
            # add labels 
            age_groups <- c('0-9', '10-19', '20-29', '30-39', '40-49', '50-59', '60-69', '70-79', '80+')
            category <- rep('2. Female (very high HDI)', 9)
            uvhfp_df <- cbind(age_groups, unmet, no_unmet, unmet_perc, category)
            
            # convert to df and numeric
            uvhfp_df <- as.data.frame(uvhfp_df)
            uvhfp_df$unmet_perc <- as.numeric(uvhfp_df$unmet_perc)

    # Table for unmet overall
        hdi_unmet_df <- as.data.frame(rbind(ulmp_df, ulfp_df, 
                                            ummp_df, umfp_df,
                                            uhmp_df, uhfp_df,
                                            uvhmp_df, uvhfp_df))
        
        # Add Sex and HDI for plotting purposes 
            hdi_unmet_df$sex <- rep('female', nrow(hdi_unmet_df))
            hdi_unmet_df[which(hdi_unmet_df$category %in% c('7. Male (low HDI)', '5. Male (medium HDI)', 
                                                        '3. Male (high HDI)', '1. Male (very high HDI)')), 'sex'] <- 'male'
            
            hdi_unmet_df$hdis <- rep('4. low HDI', nrow(hdi_unmet_df))
            hdi_unmet_df[which(hdi_unmet_df$category %in% c('6. Female (medium HDI)', '5. Male (medium HDI)')), 'hdis'] <- '3. medium HDI'
            hdi_unmet_df[which(hdi_unmet_df$category %in% c('4. Female (high HDI)', '3. Male (high HDI)')), 'hdis'] <- '2. high HDI'
            hdi_unmet_df[which(hdi_unmet_df$category %in% c('2. Female (very high HDI)', '1. Male (very high HDI)')), 'hdis'] <- '1. very high HDI'

    # Plot for unmet 
        pdf(file = "C:/Users/Jamie Danemayer/Documents/Gender/unmet.pdf",   # The directory you want to save the file in
            width = 7, # The width of the plot in inches
            height = 10)

        fig_unmet %>%
            ggplot(aes(x=age_groups, y=unmet_perc, group=category, color=hdis)) +
            geom_line(aes(linetype=sex, color=hdis)) +
```

```{r indicator models, echo = FALSE}
# Country fixed effects 
    # alles$country <- as.factor(alles$country)
# Strategy 
    # 1. Run models with all interaction in them 
    # 2. Report interaction for continuous vars with p values, justify stratification
    # 3. Run with variables categorised  
    # 4. Present results stratified 
    
# Need 
    need1 <- glm(any_need ~ SEX*(scale(ageby5, scale = FALSE)) + SEX*(scale(hdiby5, scale = FALSE)), data = alles_g, family = "binomial")
    need1_aic_hic <- cbind(exp(cbind(OR = coef(need1), confint(need1))), round(summary(need1)$coef, 4)) 
    
    need1s <- glm(any_need ~ SEX + age10 + hdi_score, data = alles_g, family = "binomial")
    need1_strat <- cbind(exp(cbind(OR = coef(need1s), confint(need1s))), round(summary(need1s)$coef, 4)) 

# Use
    use1 <- glm(any_use ~ SEX*(scale(ageby5, scale = FALSE)) + SEX*(scale(hdiby5, scale = FALSE)) + SEX*fdn, data = alles_g, family = "binomial")
    use1_aic_hic <- cbind(exp(cbind(OR = coef(use1), confint(use1))), round(summary(use1)$coef, 4)) 
    
    use1s <- glm(any_use ~ SEX + age10 + hdi_score + fdn, data = alles_g, family = "binomial")
    use1_strat <- cbind(exp(cbind(OR = coef(use1s), confint(use1s))), round(summary(use1s)$coef, 4))

# Unmet need
    unmet1 <- glm(any_unmet ~ SEX*(scale(ageby5, scale = FALSE)) + SEX*(scale(hdiby5, scale = FALSE)) + SEX*fdn, data = alles_g, family = "binomial")
    unmet1_aic_hic <- cbind(exp(cbind(OR = coef(unmet1), confint(unmet1))), round(summary(unmet1)$coef, 4)) 
    
    unmet1s <- glm(any_unmet ~ SEX + age10 + hdi_score + fdn, data = alles_g, family = "binomial")
    unmet1_strat <- cbind(exp(cbind(OR = coef(unmet1s), confint(unmet1s))), round(summary(unmet1s)$coef, 4))

# Save interaction tables
    i_ors <- rbind(need1_aic_hic, use1_aic_hic, unmet1_aic_hic)
    i_ors <- as.data.frame(i_ors)
    write.xlsx(i_ors, file = 'i_ors_g.xlsx', overwrite = TRUE)

# Save stratified tables
    s_ors <- rbind(need1_strat, use1_strat, unmet1_strat)
    s_ors <- as.data.frame(s_ors)
    write.xlsx(s_ors, file = 's_ors_g.xlsx', overwrite = TRUE)
```

```{r barrier models, echo = FALSE}
# Notes
    # linear regression: dependent var is cont. analyses the relationship between a continuous response variable and one or more explanatory variables, and their interactions.
    # logistic regression: dependent var is cat. type of classification model for supervisied ML, used to predict binary outcomes. Performs regression on the probabilities of the outcome being a category. 
    # logit regression: same as logistic 
    # multivariable regression: multiple outcomes, multiple predictors
    # multivariate regression: multiple outcomes, single predictor
    # multiple regression: single outcome, multiple independent variables. 

# We are doing multivariable logistic regression

table(gunmet$hdi_score)
```
